answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 45983 Country: India Title: Salah of traveller Question: If I am a traveler and in peace then if I am performing full salah not qasr then will it be ok? Answer ID: 45983 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 913/711/H=1434) Qasr is wajib on musafir who is entitled to make qasr; he has no option but to do qasr. However, he can increase the number of nafl salah, there is no harm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
